title: Secret Invasion Requiem #1 Marvel 2009 One-Shot Wasp Tribute Dan Slott Khoi Pham
condition_description: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Secret Invasion: Requiem #1 (Marvel One-Shot, January 2009), tribute to the Wasp after Secret Invasion. Written by Dan Slott, art and cover by Khoi Pham, with classic reprint material by Stan Lee, Jack Kirby and Jim Shooter. Direct Edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: The Dark Knight Blu-ray ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
